_comment: Hand corrections for cabins.v1.json, keyed by Recreation.gov facility id. Re-check every winter. include: facilities the sweeps can't find by name (fetched by seed-cabins.mjs). overrides: any site field (name, kind, lat, lng, coords_approximate, season_status, season_notes, state); force: true keeps a facility the automatic rules would leave out. exclude: ids to leave off the map, with the reason. extra: non-Recreation.gov cabins, written out in full like manual-lookouts.json.

10005414.season_notes: Recreation.gov lists no coordinates; the pin uses the Forest Service's Upper Stillwater House record, about 22 miles up Rock Creek Road from Mountain Home.
